name: Composio
description: Connect 500+ apps (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Calendar and more) to your agent through one managed MCP server.
notes: Uses Composio's hosted MCP server (Composio Connect). One connection exposes Composio's meta-tools for searching and executing actions across connected apps; individual apps are linked from the Composio dashboard at https://platform.composio.dev. The API key is sent in the x-consumer-api-key header.
installHint: Paste your Composio consumer API key from https://platform.composio.dev/settings - the same key works for every app you connect in Composio.

headerFields.label: Composio API key
headerFields.helperText: Created in Composio under Settings → API Keys on [platform.composio.dev](https://platform.composio.dev). Sent as the x-consumer-api-key header to authenticate the MCP connection.
